content.value_statement: FigJam plugin development can fail when the CLI, WebSocket server, and plugin consoles disagree. This skill gives a focused checklist for diagnosing connection, sync, and patch problems.
actual_capabilities: Explains the CLI, plugin UI, and plugin main connection flow.
Maps common symptoms to likely causes and local checks.
Guides inspection of CLI output, plugin UI console, and Figma development console.
Documents WebSocket hello, full, patch, and request-full message flow.
Lists JSON import expectations for DSL and IR node formats.
Provides a quick local WebSocket test using the configured server port.
limitations: Does not include executable helper scripts or automated diagnostics.
Assumes the project uses the FigJam plugin architecture described in the skill.
Does not resolve WebSocket server bugs without access to project source code.
Requires local tools such as Bun or a WebSocket client for some checks.

use_cases.title: Restore Diagram Sync
use_cases.description: Diagnose why diagram changes do not reach the FigJam canvas.

use_cases.title: Triage Console Errors
use_cases.description: Compare CLI, plugin UI, and plugin main logs during connection failures.

use_cases.title: Validate WebSocket Setup
use_cases.description: Check ports, secrets, document identifiers, and test client behavior.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Connection Check
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner check for a stalled plugin connection.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me debug a FigJam plugin that stays on Connecting. Ask for the CLI output, plugin UI console, and server port.

prompt_templates.title: Sync Failure Triage
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate diagnosis for connected plugins without canvas updates.
prompt_templates.prompt: A diagram connects but canvas updates do not appear. Walk through likely causes using the debug-connection checklist.

prompt_templates.title: Message Flow Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my FigJam plugin WebSocket flow. Check hello, full, patch, and reconnect behavior against the expected sequence.

prompt_templates.title: Full Incident Diagnosis
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a step-by-step diagnosis plan for CLI errors, port conflicts, secret mismatch, docId mismatch, and patch failures.

output_examples.input: The plugin shows Connecting and the CLI window is quiet.
output: Confirm the local server is running on the expected port.
Inspect the plugin UI console for connection errors.
Check that the plugin targets the same document and port.

output_examples.input: The canvas does not update after diagram changes.
output: Check CLI validation output for diagram errors.
Inspect the plugin main console for render failures.
Verify that patch messages are received after the initial full update.

output_examples.input: A manual WebSocket test connects but no full update arrives.
output: Compare the document identifier used by the client and source file.
Check whether a shared secret is required on both sides.
Request a fresh full update after reconnecting.

best_practices: Check the CLI, plugin UI, and plugin main consoles before changing source code.
Verify secrets, document identifiers, and ports with the same values on both sides.
Reproduce failures with a minimal diagram before debugging complex content.
anti_patterns: Assuming the canvas renderer is broken before checking connection state.
Changing several connection settings at once during diagnosis.
Ignoring validation errors from the CLI build step.

faq.question: What problems does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps debug FigJam plugin connection, sync, and patch application failures.

faq.question: Does it run commands automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and command examples for local debugging.

faq.question: Can it fix Figma account or permission issues?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on local plugin connection behavior and project diagnostics.

faq.question: Does it cover JSON import errors?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents expected JSON structure for DSL and IR node formats.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, or Claude Code use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What should I collect before using it?
faq.answer: Collect CLI output, plugin UI console logs, plugin main console logs, and connection settings.
